cases.brief: Announce an internal prototype that reduced median queue time from 12 minutes to 8 minutes. Explain that this is a small test, and thank the operations team.

outputs.generic: Our internal prototype reduced median queue time from 12 minutes to 8 minutes in a small test. Thank you to the operations team for making this progress possible.
outputs.exemplar: We shortened the queue. In a small internal test, median wait fell from 12 minutes to 8. Thank you to the operations team. Next, we test whether it holds.
outputs.hvm:
12 minutes became 8.

That is the median queue time in our small internal prototype test. The operations team made it possible.

Now we need to see whether the result holds.
outputs.hybrid:
Median queue time: 12 minutes to 8.

A useful result from a small internal prototype test. Thank you to the operations team for the work behind it.

The next question is whether it holds.

cases.brief: Explain why a fictional startup is spending this month improving reliability before adding features. Do not claim numerical improvements.

outputs.generic: This month, our startup is focusing on reliability before adding new features. We want the features customers already use to work consistently.
outputs.exemplar: Reliability begins with the work already in front of us. This month, we are improving what exists before adding more.
outputs.hvm:
A feature only helps when it works.

This month, we are improving reliability before adding new features. We want to earn confidence in what is already here.
outputs.hybrid:
This month, reliability comes first.

Before we add new features, we are working on the ones people already depend on.

Our priority is consistency.

cases.brief: Invite colleagues to test an early dashboard and submit one specific improvement. Make clear this is an internal prototype.

outputs.generic: Please try our early internal dashboard prototype and suggest one specific improvement. Your feedback will help us decide what to change next.
outputs.exemplar:
Try the dashboard. Tell us one thing to improve.

It is an early internal prototype, and specific feedback will help us decide what to change.
outputs.hvm:
